paper.title: Explore, Select, Derive, and Recall: Augmenting LLM with Human-like Memory for Mobile Task Automation
paper.source_title: MobileGPT: Augmenting LLM with Human-like App Memory for Mobile Task Automation
paper.central_claim: MobileGPT把移动任务拆成可复用子任务及参数化动作并留存于app记忆，以82.7%执行新任务、98.75%适配准确率和62.5%/68.8%时延/成本下降实现可靠高效重复任务自动化。

provenance.notes: 按已配置sonnet→gpt-6.1-sol派发；无独立路由回执/会话ID，不探测。 固定v3正文题名为MobileGPT，manifest沿用Explore, Select, Derive, and Recall旧题名；ID/version/hash一致，保留两者不静默改身份。

sections_read: 全文§1–10，方法、比较/消融/用户研究、讨论；该版本无另列附录

evidence.quote: successfully completes the user instruction, it stores the task as a collection of node and sub-task pairs.
evidence.support_explanation: 完成后任务/子任务图被保存，支持非权重留存。

evidence.quote: These errors can be detected by monitoring the screen changes and tracking the visited app screens.
evidence.support_explanation: UI执行/循环反馈能纠错，但不验证语义目标完成。

evidence.quote: If the value of the attribute matches that of the subtask parameter, the attribute’s value is replaced with the corresponding parameter name.
evidence.support_explanation: 去实例化动作支持新参数复用。

evidence.quote: In any case, the provided example always demonstrates a correct answer.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者假定供fewshot的轨迹正确；独立自动验证未证明。

evidence.quote: When an error occurred, we allowed the system three additional attempts for self-correction.
evidence.support_explanation: 主结果含人工错误识别与额外重试，须限制自主单次结论。

evidence.quote: To ensure a fair evaluation in the comparison study, we did not utilize
evidence.support_explanation: 比较研究未用HITL修复；与消融研究的修复不同。

evidence.quote: If it fails to correct itself, we mark the task as a failure and manually repair the error using the HITL task repair.
evidence.support_explanation: 冷启动失败后人工修复被存入记忆，98.75%不是全自主学习收益。

evidence.quote: achieves near-perfect accuracy (98.75%) during the warm-start phase, with a single exception observed in Uber Eats.
evidence.support_explanation: 80任务变参回放79成功，作者报告。

evidence.quote: The total cost for this random exploration was $10.78
evidence.support_explanation: 披露预探索成本；需与冷/暖启动及人工修复一起摊销。

evidence.quote: dramatically reduces latency and cost, achieving improvements of 62.5% and 68.8% over the baseline, respectively.
evidence.support_explanation: 同题变参条件下时延/成本收益。

evidence.quote: due to an error while recalling a task from memory.
evidence.support_explanation: 无HITL比较中暖启动多一次失败；不是普遍准确率提升。

evidence.quote: We recruited 23 participants (16 male, 7 female, mean age 23.2, SD=3.5, range=19-32)
evidence.support_explanation: 用户研究分母，与主任务评测统计分开。

evidence.quote: does not support mobile apps that lack text representation of their screen layouts
evidence.support_explanation: 文本可访问性限定支持范围。

evidence.quote: This baseline is designed to share the same prompts as
evidence.support_explanation: 有提示对齐的Derive-only控制，但分解与记忆效果仍捆绑。

evidence.quote: Comparisons were made only for tasks successfully completed by all three systems (77 tasks).
evidence.support_explanation: 成本比较条件选择，仅共同成功任务，不含失败总成本。

evidence.quote: Therefore, when the attribute-based adaptation fails, we resort to LLM to re-derive the action once again.

signatures.object: 按app持久化的page→subtask→action图与参数化已完成任务
signatures.information: Accessibility HTML屏幕、当前指令、可用子任务、屏幕变化和用户修复
signatures.operation: 离线探索枚举子任务→Select→Derive执行/反馈→保存图边/任务；动作属性去实例化
signatures.output: 任务图、通用子任务函数调用和动作模板
signatures.conditions: 可访问性文本及可匹配UI属性；失败可用LLM或用户修复
signatures.feedback: 无效UI、屏幕不变/循环；LLM Finish；用户纠错
signatures.selection_rule: 完成任务后保存；自动完成判定主要LLM，用户修复优先
signatures.selection_data: 冷启动任务，消融失败可人工修复
signatures.persistence: 本地app memory，跨任务共用page/subtask edges；无权重更新
signatures.later_use: 高层任务匹配→参数填槽→属性重绑定回放，失败用旧正确动作fewshot重派生
signatures.claimed_effect: 变参任务可靠回放、降低调用成本与延迟
signatures.failure_boundary: 缺文本/关键UI属性、语义完成错误、app更新、不可撤回动作；需用户支持

gap.author_gap: LLM任务自动化不稳定且每次昂贵；既有宏泛化对UI/参数变化脆弱。
gap.checked_gap: 任务/子任务复用可减少重复推理；本文具体的图与参数重绑定回应重复执行问题，不代表任意新任务能力增长。

lineage.name: AutoDroid、AppAgent、macro mining、Sugilite式属性泛化、LLM response caching

gap.closest_adjacent: AppAgent/AutoDroid应用知识与传统宏脚本；只审本篇比较，未独立核其全部差异。
gap.residue: 在共享子任务及变化参数/屏幕下低开销复用而非每次重推理
gap.stakes: 常见移动重复任务延迟、成本与一致性
gap.method_response: 可参数化subtask图和确定性属性适配；失败fallback/用户纠错
gap.remaining_gap: 完成判定可靠性、跨任务族独立泛化、长程app变化及修复摊销
unresolved: 缺AutoDroid、AppAgent和相关macro mining原文；请求固定版本用于最近邻独立核对。

condition_checks.reason: 去实例化子任务、匹配重绑定及后续读取明确；成功门控依赖LLM/人，独立新族留出与顺序方差不足。

expectations.applies_when: 分别报告自主构建与人工修复后回放、区分重试/构造任务与真正留出
expectations.reason: 比较研究不人工修复但人工监测/最多三次重试；98.75%来自修复后同任务变参而非独立新族。

expectations.applies_when: 保持相同提示/底模、移除记忆或分解进行独立控制
expectations.reason: Derive-only同提示对照有用；记忆/分解及人工修复收益仍未全部因子化。

expectations.applies_when: 经验应去实例化、验证并能失败回退
expectations.reason: 属性参数化及LLM fallback明确；独立语义成功验证、版本回滚不完整。

expectations.applies_when: 披露学习/探索、失败与人工修复全成本并报告摊销
expectations.reason: 预探索$10.78与冷暖成本披露；共同成功子集、人工耗时/失败和长期摊销不足。

expectations.applies_when: 给主任务置信区间/多流顺序方差而非只用户研究显著性
expectations.reason: 80变参任务及185比较有失败分母；主结果无多次运行/流顺序区间，用户研究显著性不替代。

claims.selection_vs_test: 冷启动执行构造记忆；暖启动重复同题
claims.counterevidence: 人工监测错误并给三次重试，不是无人监督单次；暖启动并未提升准确率
claims.allowed_conclusion: 所测手机文本界面下、带评估者监测重试的系统能力

claims.selection_vs_test: 第一指令冷启动并修复→第二指令同题变参暖启动
claims.result_denominator: 79/80暖启动成功；327动作中53需LLM适配且全部正确，作者报告
claims.counterevidence: 失败冷启动人工修复后的留存，不证明自主新任务族泛化；缺全成本摊销
